## Personal logo

Create a simple mark that remains recognizable at a small size and can work in one colour. The challenge is reduction: decide what is essential and remove what is not.

## Personal emblem

Create a richer visual that can combine place, heritage, interests, values, aspirations, symbols, and the personal logo. The challenge is synthesis: several ideas should work together rather than becoming a pile of unrelated symbols.

## Make it physical

A strong design may later become a laser-cut or engraved object, a 3D-printed badge, or a vinyl decal. Fabrication constraints become part of the design problem.
